title: お弁当つめつめ！ ～BENTO BOX～
tagline: おかずを回して、ぴったり詰める。全6弁当。
coreMechanic: Rotate (no mirror) four tetromino-shaped side dishes and pack them into a 4x4 lacquer bento box with no gaps; 6 fixed stages with an explicit next-stage confirm

inputs.drag: mouse/touch drag a tray dish, snaps to grid, green legal / red illegal preview, release to place; pointercancel never places
inputs.tap: tap a tray dish to select, tap a box cell: the dish covers that cell (first food cell preferred)
inputs.keyboard: 1-4 or Tab+Enter select; arrows move; R rotates; Enter/Space place; Esc deselect/pause; key repeat ignored
inputs.rotate: on-screen 44px button or R, selected unplaced dish only
inputs.remove: tap/drag/Enter on a placed dish returns it to the tray (counts as undo)
inputs.pause: button/Escape; blur/visibility hidden auto-pause; active drags released

practice: Isolated IIOO board, repeatable, all inputs, completion message; never touches score/BEST/storage
scoring: per stage max(0,1000-3*floor(activeSeconds)-20*acceptedRotations-50*removals); invalid drops cost nothing; run total 0..6000; BEST only after all 6 stages
save: web-mini-arcade:v1:game037:best:rules1 {best} and web-mini-arcade:v1:game037:mute only; memory fallback when storage is refused
telemetry: none (no analytics/telemetry/network calls in this prototype)
art: hand-authored original SVG (bento box, 7 dishes, noren, washi/wood tiles, seal, sparkle); no image generation; see docs/game037/ASSET_INDEX.md
